subject: general
question: If the HCF of two numbers is 12 and LCM of the same numbers is 48, then the square root of the product of these numbers is:
solution:
**Given:**

The HCF of two numbers = 12

The LCM of two numbers = 48

**Formula used:**

Product of two numbers = (HCF of two numbers) × (LCM of two numbers)

**Calculation:**

⇒ Product of the numbers = 12 × 48 = 576

⇒ Square root of the product of the numbers = √576 = 24

**∴ The required result will be 24.**
